config.prompt: Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.

reference.text:
A message that changes his life forever.
The lighthouse keeper, Jack, had been stationed on the rocky coast for five years. He had grown accustomed to the solitude, the rhythmic sound of the waves, and the occasional visit from a passing ship. But on this particular day, something caught his eye. A bottle, half-buried in the sand, caught the morning sun and glinted like a tiny jewel. Jack walked over to investigate, his boots sinking into the damp sand.

As he picked up the bottle, he noticed it was old, the glass worn and weathered. He carefully removed the cork and peered inside. A piece of paper, yellowed with age, was tied to a small rock. Jack untied the paper and smoothed it out, revealing a message scrawled in hasty handwriting:

"Dear whoever finds this,

My name is Emily. I was on a ship that sank in a storm off this coast. I was the only survivor. I've been living on this island for months, but I'm running out of food and hope. If you find this, please know that I'm still alive. I'm hiding in a cave on the north side of the island. Please come for me.

Yours,
Emily"
